slug: 2024-01-01 Cabo Verde data protection - Digital Regulations in the Metaverse Era (IBA)

facts.fact: The IBA chapter states that Law 133/V/2001 is Cabo Verde's general data protection regime, applying within the country and to processing of data of people located in it; the document gives no event date, so the 2024 publication year is used.

The IBA chapter states the law establishes the National Data Protection Commission (CNPD) as the independent supervisory authority, without saying it is constituted or acting; the document gives no event date, so the 2024 publication year is used.
